text:
maria_runtime: heads-up: canary p95 (short-seq) jumped ~2.8x after the recent runtime merge. noticed ~09:12 UTC and reproduces only on canary nodes.
ci-bot: perf-ci: decode_shortseq_p95 job failed — https://ci.internal/redwood/job/2543 (logs linked)
lee_perf: ran a short microbench on a canary pod. flame shows KV eviction churn + attention kernel fallback + scheduler requeues.
lee_perf: flame snippet:
```
0.30s  kv_eviction::sweep
0.14s  attention_select::fallback_path
0.10s  batch_router::reschedule
```
vikas: I suspect the new KV eviction hysteresis we added in commit abc1234 (part of the fused-op scheduler cleanup).
jess: that landed in PR #4281 as part of the scheduler refactor. @vikas can you bisect to the offending commit/PR?
maria_runtime: hold canary roll — this is a rollout blocker for the runtime release.
oncall: +1 hold. marking release as canary-hold :rotating_light:
vikas: starting git bisect across ~32 commits (abc1234..def5678). will post the bad commit when found.
lee_perf: local microbench (shortseq=8, batch=1) reproduces: baseline p95 ~11ms -> canary p95 ~33ms with hysteresis enabled.
lee_perf: quick mitigation: flip feature flag `shortseq_kv_hysteresis` off on canary and re-run.
ops-bot: executed: `rctl feature set shortseq_kv_hysteresis=false --env canary` — toggle applied to 7/8 canary pods without restart.
lee_perf: after flag toggle, p95 on canary returned to ~12ms. numbers match baseline.
ci-bot: perf-ci: rerun queued job 2544 — https://ci.internal/redwood/job/2544
maria_runtime: proposed next steps: 1) revert the hysteresis change (open revert PR), 2) produce a full perf repro with traces + flamegraphs, 3) keep release on canary-hold until revert verified.
vikas: opened revert PR #4305 (will attach bisect output). bisect identified bad commit: abc1234. running full microbench suite now.
jess: I'll assemble perf traces and upload to s3://redwood-perf/shortseq_hysteresis/1767777777 (traces + perf map + flame).
oncall: incident tag `runtime-shortseq-p95` added and on-call leads paged.
maria_runtime: assigning: @vikas for the revert PR, @lee_perf for verification on canary. keep updates here. leaving rollout-blocker until followups green :white_check_mark:
